notes.title: Streamlining the Player Experience
notes.content:
Hello,

We have been going through user reviews and other sources of feedback and have decided to streamline the user experience to decrease time spent in the tutorial phase so the player has limited hurdles prior to experiencing the fun.
[olist]
[*]Limited the number of interactions in the tutorial phase of Chapter 1.
[*]Limited the number of phases in Chapter 2 to limit repetition of gameplay.
[*]Streamlined player time before they are faced with significant environmental gameplay mechanics at the end of Chapter 1, in Chapter 2 and in Chapter 3.
[*]Increased the controller velocity threshold required for melee weapons to have any impact on enemies.
[*]Tied the speed of the meteor spell to the impact on enemies.
[/olist]
We will also be monitoring feedback on difficulty closely going forward. Prior to launch, our testers indicated parts of this game were somewhat too difficult, which we scaled back. We may bring back the difficulty levels we initially started with.

Thanks all!
